title: ADR-003: Terminate TLS at the gateway
summary: TLS terminates at the api-gateway; internal traffic uses mTLS.

title: ADR-004: Short-lived access tokens
summary: Access tokens live 15 minutes, refresh tokens 30 days.

title: ADR-005: Feature flags in config-svc
summary: All feature flags are served by config-svc with a local cache in each service.

title: ADR-006: Nightly warehouse batch
summary: Copy events to the warehouse in a nightly batch.

title: ADR-008: Cart state in redis
summary: Cart state is stored in redis-cache with a 7-day TTL.

title: ADR-009: Idempotency keys on every payout write
summary: Keep idempotency keys on every payout write.

title: ADR-010: Rules engine owns hand-written rules
summary: Hand-written risk rules run in rules-engine, separate from the ML score.

title: ADR-011: KYC documents in object storage
summary: KYC documents are stored encrypted in s3-docs, never in a database.

title: ADR-012: Mobile backend-for-frontend
summary: Mobile apps talk to a dedicated mobile-bff, not to services directly.

title: ADR-013: Email through a single sender
summary: All transactional email goes through email-svc with one sending domain.

title: ADR-014: Event bus on kafka
summary: Internal events go through event-bus backed by kafka with 7-day retention.

title: ADR-015: Support refunds go through support-api
summary: Support refunds are executed by support-api, never by direct database edits.

title: ADR-016: Referral rewards capped per user
summary: Referral rewards are capped at 10 per user per month.

title: ADR-017: Synchronous payment chain with inline risk check
summary: Checkout calls payments synchronously; payments calls fraud-svc inline before capture.

title: ADR-018: Gateway rate limits per merchant
summary: Rate limits are applied per merchant key, not per IP.

title: ADR-019: Feature store snapshots for training
summary: ml-features keeps daily snapshots so fraud models train on point-in-time data.

title: ADR-020: Payout batches every 15 minutes
summary: payouts-worker sends payout batches every 15 minutes instead of hourly.

title: ADR-021: Session storage in redis
summary: auth-svc stores sessions in redis-cache with write-through to disk.

title: ADR-022: Streaming warehouse ingestion
summary: warehouse-sync streams events from event-bus instead of a nightly batch.

title: ADR-023: Push notification quiet hours
summary: Marketing pushes are not sent between 22:00 and 08:00 local time.

title: ADR-024: Checkout web server-side rendering
summary: checkout-web renders on the server for faster first paint.

title: ADR-025: Admin console single sign-on
summary: admin-console requires company SSO with hardware keys.

title: ADR-026: Reporting API read replica
summary: reporting-api reads from a pg-main replica, never the primary.

title: ADR-027: Cart merges on login
summary: An anonymous cart merges into the user's cart on login.
